script.title: OVERBOOKED AT GATE B12
script.story_hook: Gate B12 is overbooked, and Ana must get home.
script.intro_zh: B12登機口超賣，安娜卻非趕不可。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to tonight's busy gate. Big plans, one small problem.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到今晚熱鬧的登機口，有大安排，也有小狀況。
script.outro: One bump, one voucher, one wedding saved. Ask, listen, then choose. See you!
script.outro_zh: 一次改簽、一張代金券、一場婚禮保住了。先問、先聽、再選。下次見！
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat the gate conversation line by line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們把登機口的對話逐句跟讀一次。
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her early thirties, wavy auburn hair in a loose bun, gold hoop earrings, an emerald raincoat over a floral dress, carry-on bag with a garment sleeve, average build, hopeful tired smile
script.char_b_description: a kind-faced man in his forties, short salt-and-pepper hair, rectangular glasses, navy airline blazer with a silver wing pin, light blue shirt, lanyard ID badge, stocky build, practiced calm expression

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, why is the gate screen red?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi waɪz ðə ɡeɪt skɹin ɹɛd/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，為什麼登機口螢幕是紅的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, you've seen it. We're overbooked.
dialogue.zh: 啊，您看到了，這個航班超賣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Overbooked? On a full red-eye?
dialogue.zh: 超賣？這麼晚的紅眼航班也超賣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seats sold, bodies don't match.
dialogue.zh: 賣出去的座位，跟實際人數對不上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a new one for me.
dialogue.zh: 這我還頭一回遇到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, we need one volunteer tonight.
dialogue.zh: 所以我們今晚需要一位自願的旅客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Volunteer? For what exactly?
dialogue.zh: 自願？自願做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the 7 a.m. tomorrow, with perks.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə ˈsɛvən ˈeɪˈɛm təˈmɑɹoʊ wɪð pɜɹks/
dialogue.zh: 搭明早七點的班機，還有補貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perks like what? I'm listening.
dialogue.zh: 補貼是什麼？我在聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four hundred, hotel, meals, lounge.
dialogue.zh: 四百塊、飯店、餐食、貴賓室。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm. But tomorrow's my sister's wedding.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，可是明天是我姊姊的婚禮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh. That changes the math, yeah.
dialogue.zh: 噢，那算帳就不一樣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My dress, my gift, all in my bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ dɹɛs maɪ ɡɪft ɔːl ɪn maɪ bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 我的禮服、禮物，都在行李裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, let me look at options.
dialogue.zh: 好，讓我看看別的辦法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please. Um, anything before seven?
dialogue.zh: 拜託，呃，七點之前有沒有航班？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One flight, five forty-five, tiny plane.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn flaɪt faɪv ˈfɔɹti faɪv ˈtaɪni pleɪn/
dialogue.zh: 有一班，四點四十五，小飛機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tiny is fine. Does it go straight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaɪni ɪz faɪn dʌz ɪt ɡoʊ streɪt/
dialogue.zh: 小沒關係，是直飛嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, nonstop. Wait, two open seats.
dialogue.zh: 對，直飛。等等，還有兩個空位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two? Why are seats still open?
dialogue.zh: 兩個？為什麼還有空位？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Weather delay earlier, some rebooked.
dialogue.zh: 先前天氣延誤，有人改簽走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's our lucky twist, then.
dialogue.zh: 那這就是我們的轉機了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe. Baggage is the catch.
dialogue.zh: 也許吧，但行李有個關卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I really need this flight, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過我真的需要搭這班。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Understood. Here's the plan.
dialogue.zh: 了解，聽我說計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm all ears, seriously.
dialogue.zh: 我認真聽著，你說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You keep tonight's flight, seat fourteen B.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kip təˈnaɪts flaɪt sit fɔɹˈtin bi/
dialogue.zh: 你保留今晚的班機，十四B座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's middle... but okay, go on.
dialogue.zh: 那是中間位……好吧，你繼續。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll move you to the exit row, free.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl muv ju tə ði ˈɛɡzɪt ɹaʊ fri/
dialogue.zh: 我免費幫你挪到緊急出口那一排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? Space, and my dress fits?
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？有空間，禮服也放得下？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Carry-on fits, no worries there.
dialogue.zh: 手提行李放得下，那個不用擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay... what do I get for tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ wʌt du aɪ ɡɛt fɚ təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好……那今晚我有什麼補償？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're not giving up anything now.
dialogue.zh: 你現在什麼都不用放棄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, sorry, keep going please.
dialogue.zh: 對，抱歉，請繼續說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But if bumped later, you're first in line.
dialogue.phonetic: /bət ɪf bʌmpd ˈleɪɾɚ jɚ fɜɹst ɪn laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 但之後若再超賣，你優先拿補貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, this flight could still bump?
dialogue.zh: 等等，這班還是可能超賣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small chance. I'd sleep light tonight.
dialogue.zh: 機會很小，但今晚淺眠一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, not funny, but okay.
dialogue.zh: 哈，一點都不好笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Jokes help, sorry. Meal voucher.
dialogue.zh: 開個玩笑抱歉，這是餐券。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks. Where do I eat with this?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks wɛɹ du aɪ it wɪð ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，這張能在哪裡吃？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any cafe in the terminal, all of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni kəˈfe ɪn ðə ˈtɜɹmənəl ɔːl ʌv ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 航廈裡任何一間餐飲店都可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, ramen at midnight, sold.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，半夜吃拉麵，我願意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, we're making memories.
dialogue.zh: 看，我們這是在創造回憶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Memories with noodle soup, fine.
dialogue.zh: 配湯麵的回憶，好吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, boarding starts in fifteen minutes.
dialogue.zh: 登機十五分鐘後開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wait here or at baggage?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ weɪt hɪɹ ɔɹ æt ˈbæɡɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 我在這等，還是去行李轉盤等？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here. I'll wave you when it's time.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ aɪl weɪv ju wɛn ɪts taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，到時候我揮手叫你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And my seat change, is it done?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd maɪ sit tʃeɪndʒ ɪz ɪt dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 那座位更換，已經處理好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, reprinted pass, here you go.
dialogue.zh: 好了，登機證重印，給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exit row, window... you legend.
dialogue.zh: 出口排、靠窗……你太神了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's the job, but thanks, truly.
dialogue.zh: 這是工作，但我真心道謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you text me the gate number too?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju tɛkst mi ðə ɡeɪt ˈnʌmbɚ tu/
dialogue.zh: 可以再傳簡訊告訴我登機口嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Already sent, with a boarding photo.
dialogue.zh: 已經發了，還附了登機照。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are scary good at this.
dialogue.zh: 你強得讓人害怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll take that as a medal.
dialogue.zh: 我就把它當成獎牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is one. Thank you, kind sir.
dialogue.zh: 它就是，謝謝你，好人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go find your ramen, get some sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ faɪnd jɔɹ ˈɹɑːmən ɡɛt səm slip/
dialogue.zh: 去吃你的拉麵，抓點睡眠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will do. See you at boarding.
dialogue.zh: 好的，登機時再見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more thing, good luck at the wedding.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ ɡʊd lʊk æt ðə ˈwɛdɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 還有，婚禮上祝你好運。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You just made tonight easy.
dialogue.zh: 你讓我的今晚變得很輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Safe flight. Next passenger, please!
dialogue.zh: 旅途平安。下一位旅客，謝謝！

script.youtube_title_en: I Really Need This Flight - A Wedding Dash at an Overbooked Gate
script.youtube_description:
「I really need this flight!」登機口螢幕變紅，班機超賣，而你隔天早上得趕到婚禮現場。這一集 60 句美式英文對話：從問補償、聽懂條件，到拿到餐券與靠窗的緊急出口座位。

你會聽到：
- 聽懂狀況：We're overbooked. / we need one volunteer tonight.
- 談條件：Perks like what? / Four hundred, hotel, meals, lounge.
- 說出自己的限制：Tomorrow's my sister's wedding.
- 收尾確認：Boarding starts in fifteen minutes.

整個故事只有一個場景：深夜的B12登機口，一段越談越清楚的真實對話。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，先聽懂、再開口，不用背，多聽就會用。

適合常搭飛機、想在國外用英文處理突況的 A2 初級學習者。

喜歡就訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺，每週一個新場景。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so the phrases stick without memorizing.

這一集帶大家走進深夜的 B12 登機口：安娜要趕姊姊的婚禮，站務人員用一碗拉麵的時間找出辦法。

你會聽到：
- 💺 聽懂狀況：So, we need one volunteer tonight.
